title: Low-Depth Image Circuits: code for Typical Machine Learning Datasets as Low-Depth Quantum Circuits
description:
Code for representing image datasets as low-depth quantum circuits, optimizing these circuits, and benchmarking quantum classifiers on them, as described in F. J. Kiwit, B. Jobst, A. Luckow, F. Pollmann, and C. A. Riofrío, Typical Machine Learning Datasets as Low-Depth Quantum Circuits, Quantum Science and Technology 10, 045035 (2025), doi:10.1088/2058-9565/ae0123.

The optimized circuits for the MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and Imagenette datasets produced with this code are available via PennyLane Datasets at https://pennylane.ai/datasets/collection/low-depth-image-circuits and are documented in DATASHEET.md.
